_comment: Where the bones of `agesandtheart:whalefall` land: on the sea bed, in the abyss and nowhere else.
`OCEAN_FLOOR_WG` is the first place above the floor, and `minecraft:template` builds up from the
position it is given, so the bones rest on the bed.
The `biome` filter at the end is what confines it -- it re-checks the biome at the chosen position, so
a sea bed that pokes above the abyss line gets nothing. It is also the one thing here that can be
tightened or loosened: the abyss biome reaches from the bed up to the abyss line, and nothing else in
